spans.s: Kṣemarāja (LL), title of a pious king.

kṣetra (EI 24), a department or committee.
 (SII 1), a sacred place. Cf. Varāha-kṣetra.

Kṣetrapa (IE 8-3; HD), same as Kṣetrapāla; superintendent^1 of the king's Khās Mahāl. See Ind. Ant., Vol. XV, p. 306.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210207. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/51.
Kṣetrapāla (IE 8-3; EI 17; HD), same as Kṣetrapa. Cf. Ep. Ind., Vol. XVII, p. 321.
